verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents native embedding as generally available ('Embed without an API call'). The quickstart states that it embeds your text on both writes and queries, so you don't integrate an embedding provider at all. That directly replaces a separate embedding pipeline at both ingest and query time. Missing for 10: details on which built-in models are available or whether external model providers can be configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the native embedding feature.
